title: Do Raaste
writer: Chandrakant Kakodkar, G.R. Kamath, Akhtar Romani
actors: Rajesh Khanna, Mumtaz Askari, Balraj Sahni
plot: Navendu toils hard to support his joint family and keep it together. However, their familial bond gets threatened when his younger brother marries a woman who insists on living separately.
